costs.title: What the store holds
costs.builds_sub: {count, plural, one {# build} other {# builds}} · {files} files, in Multi-AZ
costs.prices: Estimated at {oneZone} per GB and month in One Zone (pages), {multiAz} in Multi-AZ (bundles).
costs.egress: Egress excluded: 75 GB free a month, then €0.01 per GB, followed in Grafana.
costs.counters: These figures tell what the passes wrote, not what an expiry rule has deleted since: on staging, pages expire after 14 days, a completed unit is not rewritten and its pages fall back to the SSR silently.
costs.retired: A retired epoch keeps costing until the store's lifecycle has deleted it, 500,000 objects a day at most: 9 days at least for 4 million pages.
costs.projection_title: If a new epoch were written
costs.projection: It would weigh ≈ {size} like the served epoch: + {cost} / month while both coexist (until the old one is retired, 9 days at least after the switch).
costs.bill_note: The bill also counts the egress and the requests, which the estimate leaves out.

switch.step_variable: In the ENV_PROD (or ENV_STAGING) secret, set:
